answer:
Headline results for run /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20 (Brady Hot Springs PoroTomo DAS, March 2016; stride 20):

- Records analysed: 759 (2016-03-18T02:09:17Z to 2016-03-26T00:59:44Z, covering 3.314% of the time window).
- Anomalous records (|robust z| > 5): 57.
- DAS detections: 62 detections in 53 records; relative b = 0.9849 (34 above the catalogue Mc).
- Pumping: injected 4.654e+05 m3, extracted 5.059e+05 m3, net -4.048e+04 m3 over 15.96 days.
- Catalogue: 5 events, ML -0.48 to 0.07 (GDR 859, LBNL/NCEDC March 2016).

CALIBRATED probability (catalogue-based, LBNL/NCEDC, Shapiro et al. 2021 Eq. 5) — Sigma and P(M>=5.5) per year for each b scenario:
- b = 1.0:  Sigma = -5.449,  P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.0001198  (P(M>=5.5) for the observed volume = 5.236e-06;  P(M>=3)/yr = 0.03719)
- b = 0.73: Sigma = -5.319,  P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.004922   (observed-volume P(M>=5.5) = 0.0002155; P(M>=3)/yr = 0.2809)
- b = 0.65: Sigma = -5.281,  P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.01474    (observed-volume P(M>=5.5) = 0.0006484; P(M>=3)/yr = 0.4653)

UPPER BOUND (DAS-based, uncalibrated magnitudes; every detection counted as an event at or above the catalogue Mc, so it over-counts):
- b = 0.9849, Sigma = -2.698, P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.07842.

Which is which: the CALIBRATED numbers are the catalogue-based (LBNL/NCEDC) Shapiro et al. 2021 Eq. 5 probabilities per b scenario (Sigma ~ -5.3 to -5.4, P(Mw>=5.5)/yr ~ 1.2e-4 to 1.5e-2). The UPPER BOUND is the DAS-based estimate with uncalibrated magnitudes (b = 0.9849, Sigma = -2.698, P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.07842), which over-counts because all 62 DAS detections are treated as events at/above Mc. Bottom line: the calibrated catalogue-based rate of a Pohang-like Mw>=5.5 event is at most ~1.5e-2 per year (and ~1.2e-4/yr at b=1.0), while the DAS-only figure of 0.078/yr is an upper bound, not a calibrated probability.
